entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Harshit Sharma - Advocate for the petitioners.
Shri M.S. Jadon - Pp for respondent No.1/State.
Shri R.K. Joshi - Advocate for respondent No.2.

The present petition has been preferred by the
petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for quashment of Fir
registered against the petitioners for the alleged offence under Sections 420, 406 of Ipc.
Later on, it appears that better sense prevailed over the parties and they entered into compromise reflected through the application vide I.A. No.10484/2023.

Through the said application supported with affidavits, both the parties shown their intent to enter into compromise and bury their dispute,
if any and want to live peaceful marital life.
For recording intent of parties and their identification, they want to appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 23-06-2023.
Considering the aforesaid, both the parties are directed to appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 23-06-2023 for the purpose of verification of factum of compromise.
In turn, Principal Registrar is directed to verify the factum of compromise and submit its report.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Anil*
